name: moe_m32_directx_h200check2
hypothesis: For the measured M32 bottleneck, bypass shared activation staging in the row-mixed MoE GEMMs. Direct global activation operands may remove shared stores/barriers while reusing the already-hot activation tile; all other shapes retain the current staged route.
decision_reason: Official H200 check passed correctness but scored 1.9005x (95% CI 1.8720–1.9290), below current 1.9698x (CI 1.9402–1.9993). Decode-32 dropped to 1.1931x from 1.4517x; reject direct activation bypass and retain current M32 shared staging.
